# One mark and nothing else

This fixture carries a single ordinary mark, [Plain]{.index}, and none of the
shapes that make the filter define an extra preamble command. That is its
whole job: the flags saying "this document used the principal subsystem",
"this document emitted a cross-reference list" and "this document emitted a
both-targets cross-reference" are all false here, so a leaked `true` for any
of them changes this document's preamble and the comparison sees it. In the
rich fixture beside this one those flags are already true, and a leak moves
nothing.
